wood.name: Wood
wood.desc: Good dry firewood. Feeds the campfire for a while.

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.desc: Dry twigs. Needed to relight a dead fire.

stone.name: Stone
stone.desc: A sturdy stone for building and upgrades.

coal.name: Coal
coal.desc: Burns long and hot. The fire loves it.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.desc: Old canvas and scraps. Used for bandages, maps and tents.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.desc: Rusty bits of metal. Handy for tools and upgrades.

bone.name: Bone
bone.desc: Wolves love these. Offer one to a calm wolf to make a friend.

shadow_shard.name: Shadow Shard
shadow_shard.desc: A cold, glittering shard left by a Night Stalker. Traders pay well.

amber.name: Ancient Amber
amber.desc: Golden sap from an Elder Tree. Rare and valuable.

starstone.name: Starstone
starstone.desc: A stone that hums with starlight. Used for the finest gear.

berries.name: Wild Berries
berries.desc: Sweet and safe. A small snack.

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.desc: Cook it on the rack over the fire. Eating it raw can upset your tummy.

cooked_meat.name: Cooked Meat
cooked_meat.desc: Hot, hearty and safe. Restores lots of hunger.

jerky.name: Trail Jerky
jerky.desc: Dried on a rack. Light to carry, never spoils.

trail_mix.name: Trail Mix
trail_mix.desc: Nuts, raisins and a few chocolate chips.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.desc: A full first-aid kit. Restores most of your health.

rusty_axe.name: Rusty Axe
rusty_axe.desc: Old and dull, but it still chops regular trees.

good_axe.name: Good Axe
good_axe.desc: A sharp, balanced axe. Chops regular trees much faster.

mega_axe.name: Mega Axe
mega_axe.desc: A legendary axe. The only tool that can fell the giant Elder Trees.

starsteel_sword.name: Starsteel Sword
starsteel_sword.desc: Forged with Starstone. Its glow makes shadows flinch.

revolver.name: Revolver
revolver.desc: Rare and loud. Limited ammo, so make it count.

rifle.name: Rifle
rifle.desc: A powerful long-range rifle. Very rare ammo.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: Lights the way and scares most monsters. Uses battery charge.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Emergency light. Burns for a while and keeps most monsters back.

map.name: Campfire Map
map.desc: A map linked to your campfire's beacon. Press M to open.

good_sack.name: Good Sack
good_sack.desc: A proper canvas sack. Holds 12 things.

mega_sack.name: Mega Sack
mega_sack.desc: Big, tough and roomy. Holds 20 things.

best_sack.name: Best Sack
best_sack.desc: The finest sack in the forest. Holds 32 things.
